request_state.conjecture: Beal conjecture: A^x + B^y = C^z with x,y,z >= 3 has no coprime solutions. Descent on (3,3,3) in Lean 4 Euler.lean has 123 machine-checked theorems. We investigate closing the descent termination induction on N and evaluating the Darmon motivic obstruction.

candidate.claim: HYPERBOLIC ORBIFOLD EULER CHARACTERISTIC KERNEL: Rigorous evaluation of the orbifold metric chi = 1/x + 1/y + 1/z - 1 across signatures and its interaction with Darmon Frey representations.
candidate.text: The curvature chi < 0 holds for all Beal triples. U240 proved this condition is exponent-2 blind because it holds on all 10 Fermat-Catalan solutions. We evaluate whether higher Frey representations can distinguish chi.
